envOnly.reason: The tester's frontend painted bound labels in its own defaults, Excalifont 20 px: the server stores `label: {text}` with no font, and the exported file records Virgil (fontFamily 1) at 16 px. Our render keeps "12" on one line in its 44 px circle (ink 15.5x11.5), and the circle keeps its size. Re-measured at Excalifont 20, lint flags it.

unmapped.description: The 17 free texts (index labels i0-i14, lo/hi labels p-lo-t, p-hi-t) store width 60 and textAlign center but render left-aligned, so index "8" sits under the 8|9 cell boundary. Setting autoResize false later returned updated: 17 and changed nothing; fix2 moved x by a glyph-width guess.
unmapped.source: synthesis §1 #3, #4; tester A round-3 answer (3) (transcript d24dbb60, line 408); final.png
unmapped.reason: No v0 rule covers a text drawn away from its stored alignment (a stored-vs-rendered alignment mismatch). Open in this scene, so a lint without such a rule misses it.
